items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Bunk was saying that Randy Brooks was one of his best pupils

ctx.x: And, of course, at the time, the name Randy Brooks didn't mean anything to me. I mean, I'd heard the name, but I wasn't acquainted with the playing. And, but Bunk was saying that Randy Brooks was one of his best pupils, and I've always... Actually, he didn't teach him, actually. Yeah, he said he taught Randy, and I've always been curious to find out. Yeah, I don't know anything about him, either.

I never met him or heard him, but if I remember rightly, some record company had given him a contract about that time or a year or two before, maybe, and we're going to build him up to be another, say, band of the Tommy Darcy type or something like that. That's faintly in my mind. I'm not sure. I'd have to, we'll have to look that up now.
